<?php
/**
 * Mobile Backend API v2.3.1
 * Handles device registration, push notifications, and content delivery
 * Supports graceful shutdown via SIGTERM/SIGINT
 */

declare(ticks=1);

class ShutdownHandler {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $shutdownRequested = false;
    private $activeRequests = 0;
    private $logFile;
    
    private function __construct() {
        $this->logFile = '/var/log/mobile-api/requests.log';
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
    }
    
    public static function getInstance(): self {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }
    
    public function handleSignal(int $signo): void {
        $this->shutdownRequested = true;
        $this->logEvent('shutdown_requested', ['signal' => $signo]);
    }
    
    public function isShuttingDown(): bool {
        return $this->shutdownRequested;
    }
    
    public function trackRequest(): void {
        $this->activeRequests++;
    }
    
    public function releaseRequest(): void {
        $this->activeRequests--;
    }
    
    public function logEvent(string $event, array $context = []): void {
        $entry = date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . " [{$event}] " . json_encode($context) . "\n";
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class ContentRenderer {
    private $templateDir;
    private $cacheDir;
    private $allowedExtensions = ['html', 'htm', 'txt'];
    
    public function __construct(string $templateDir, string $cacheDir) {
        $this->templateDir = realpath($templateDir);
        $this->cacheDir = realpath($cacheDir);
    }
    
    /**
     * Renders content for mobile clients with device-specific adaptations
     * Uses server-side template processing for dynamic content blocks
     */
    public function renderForDevice(string $contentId, array $deviceInfo): string {
        $templateFile = $this->resolveTemplate($contentId, $deviceInfo);
        if ($templateFile === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template not found');
        }
        
        $content = file_get_contents($templateFile);
        $content = $this->processVariables($content, $deviceInfo);
        $content = $this->processIncludes($content, $deviceInfo);
        $content = $this->stripSSIDirectives($content);
        
        return $content;
    }
    
    private function resolveTemplate(string $contentId, array $deviceInfo): ?string {
        // Sanitize content ID - allow alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores
        $safeId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '', $contentId);
        $platform = $this->normalizePlatform($deviceInfo['platform'] ?? 'generic');
        
        $candidates = [
            "{$this->templateDir}/{$platform}/{$safeId}.html",
            "{$this->templateDir}/generic/{$safeId}.html",
        ];
        
        foreach ($candidates as $path) {
            if (file_exists($path) && $this->isWithinAllowedDir($path)) {
                return $path;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function normalizePlatform(string $platform): string {
        $allowed = ['ios', 'android', 'generic'];
        $normalized = strtolower(trim($platform));
        return in_array($normalized, $allowed) ? $normalized : 'generic';
    }
    
    private function processVariables(string $content, array $deviceInfo): string {
        $replacements = [
            '{{DEVICE_WIDTH}}' => intval($deviceInfo['screen_width'] ?? 375),
            '{{DEVICE_HEIGHT}}' => intval($deviceInfo['screen_height'] ?? 812),
            '{{PLATFORM}}' => htmlspecialchars($deviceInfo['platform'] ?? 'generic', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
            '{{APP_VERSION}}' => htmlspecialchars($deviceInfo['app_version'] ?? '1.0', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
            '{{LOCALE}}' => htmlspecialchars($deviceInfo['locale'] ?? 'en-US', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
        ];
        return str_replace(array_keys($replacements), array_values($replacements), $content);
    }
    
    /**
     * Process include directives in templates
     * Format: <!--#include virtual="path" -->
     * This allows modular template composition for mobile content
     */
    private function processIncludes(string $content, array $deviceInfo): string {
        $pattern = '/<!--#include\s+virtual="([^"]+)"\s*-->/i';
        
        return preg_replace_callback($pattern, function($matches) use ($deviceInfo) {
            $includePath = $matches[1];
            return $this->resolveInclude($includePath, $deviceInfo);
        }, $content);
    }
    
    private function resolveInclude(string $path, array $deviceInfo): string {
        // Resolve the include path relative to template directory
        $fullPath = $this->templateDir . '/' . $path;
        $resolved = realpath($fullPath);
        
        // Security: verify the resolved path is within allowed directories
        if ($resolved === false || !$this->isWithinAllowedDir($resolved)) {
            return '<!-- include not found -->';
        }
        
        $ext = pathinfo($resolved, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        if (!in_array($ext, $this->allowedExtensions)) {
            return '<!-- invalid include type -->';
        }
        
        $includeContent = file_get_contents($resolved);
        // Recursively process variables in included content
        return $this->processVariables($includeContent, $deviceInfo);
    }
    
    /**
     * Strip any SSI directives from output to prevent Apache mod_include
     * from processing injected directives in the response
     */
    private function stripSSIDirectives(string $content): string {
        // Remove all SSI directive patterns from final output
        $content = preg_replace('/<!--#[^>]*-->/i', '', $content);
        return $content;
    }
    
    private function isWithinAllowedDir(string $path): bool {
        $resolved = realpath($path);
        if ($resolved === false) return false;
        return $this->pathIsInside($resolved, $this->templateDir) ||
               $this->pathIsInside($resolved, $this->cacheDir);
    }
    
    /**
     * Robust containment check that avoids prefix-matching bypasses
     * (e.g. /var/www/templates_evil matching /var/www/templates).
     */
    private function pathIsInside(string $resolved, ?string $baseDir): bool {
        if ($baseDir === false || $baseDir === null || $baseDir === '') {
            return false;
        }
        // Exact match is allowed, or must be strictly under baseDir + separator
        $base = rtrim($baseDir, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
        if ($resolved === $base) {
            return true;
        }
        return strpos($resolved, $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) === 0;
    }
}

class MobileApiController {
    private $renderer;
    private $shutdown;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->shutdown = ShutdownHandler::getInstance();
        $this->renderer = new ContentRenderer(
            __DIR__ . '/templates',
            __DIR__ . '/cache'
        );
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        if ($this->shutdown->isShuttingDown()) {
            http_response_code(503);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Service shutting down', 'retry_after' => 30]);
            return;
        }
        
        $this->shutdown->trackRequest();
        
        try {
            $method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
            $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
            
            header('Content-Type: application/json');
            header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
            
            switch (true) {
                case $method === 'GET' && preg_match('#^/api/v2/content/([\w-]+)$#', $path, $m):
                    $this->getContent($m[1]);
                    break;
                case $method === 'POST' && $path === '/api/v2/device/register':
                    $this->registerDevice();
                    break;
                default:
                    http_response_code(404);
                    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Not found']);
            }
        } finally {
            $this->shutdown->releaseRequest();
        }
    }
    
    private function getContent(string $contentId): void {
        $deviceInfo = $this->extractDeviceInfo();
        
        $this->shutdown->logEvent('content_request', [
            'content_id' => $contentId,
            'device' => $deviceInfo['platform'] ?? 'unknown'
        ]);
        
        try {
            $html = $this->renderer->renderForDevice($contentId, $deviceInfo);
            header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');
            echo $html;
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            http_response_code(404);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Content not found']);
        }
    }
    
    private function extractDeviceInfo(): array {
        $headers = getallheaders();
        return [
            'platform' => $headers['X-Device-Platform'] ?? 'generic',
            'screen_width' => $headers['X-Screen-Width'] ?? '375',
            'screen_height' => $headers['X-Screen-Height'] ?? '812',
            'app_version' => $headers['X-App-Version'] ?? '1.0',
            'locale' => $headers['X-Device-Locale'] ?? 'en-US',
            'device_id' => $headers['X-Device-Id'] ?? '',
            'custom_theme' => $headers['X-Custom-Theme'] ?? 'default',
        ];
    }
    
    private function registerDevice(): void {
        $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        if (!$input || empty($input['device_id']) || empty($input['push_token'])) {
            http_response_code(400);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing required fields']);
            return;
        }
        
        // Device registration logic would go here
        echo json_encode(['status' => 'registered', 'device_id' => htmlspecialchars($input['device_id'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8')]);
    }
}

// Bootstrap
$controller = new MobileApiController();
$controller->handleRequest();
